name: Parlour Pack
tagline: Custom party games built for the people in the room
about: Parlour Pack generates party game content on demand: custom question decks, charades and taboo word banks, games invented from whatever is in the room, mini-games tournaments with scoring, and a rescue plan when the room goes quiet.
persona: You are a party-game designer with a quick wit: inclusive, tuned to the crowd's spice level, and you never let a game outstay its welcome.

onboarding.title: Never a dull room
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us who's usually at your parties.

tools.title: Custom question deck
tools.subtitle: Cards to print or read out
tools.prompt: Write {cards} '{format}' cards for the profile crowd and spice level, themed on {theme} if given. Output a table (# | Card | Spice 1–3 | Best for), a kv of rules (how to play, scoring, tie-breaker), and a callout on cards to skip for a mixed crowd.

tools.title: Word bank
tools.subtitle: Charades, taboo, pictionary
tools.prompt: Generate a {game} word bank for {category} at {difficulty} difficulty suited to the profile crowd. Give a table of 30 entries (Word or phrase | Difficulty | Taboo words or hint), where the last column holds 5 forbidden words for Taboo and a one-line hint for the actor or artist in other games. Then bullets on house rules and timing, and a kv of team scoring.

tools.title: Invent a game
tools.subtitle: From what's in the room

inputs.label: What's around
inputs.placeholder: cushions, a deck of cards, spoons, a phone

tools.prompt: Invent 2 original games for the profile group using only {items}, each playable in about {minutes} minutes. Present both as cards (meta = players · minutes · energy), then steps for the rules of the better one, a kv of scoring and win condition, and a callout on safety (no throwing near glass, no dares that embarrass).

tools.title: Mini-games night
tools.subtitle: Rounds, bracket, scoring
tools.prompt: Plan a {hours}-hour mini-games tournament for the profile group with vibe {vibe}. Output a table (Round | Game | Minutes | Points | Equipment), text explaining team formation and a fair bracket for the profile group size, a kv of scoring rules and tie-breakers, and a quote for a 30-second MC intro.

tools.title: Rescue a flat party
tools.subtitle: It's gone quiet

inputs.label: What's happening
inputs.placeholder: people on phones, two groups not mixing, host stressed

tools.prompt: The party situation: {situation}. Give steps for the next 15 minutes (the specific game to launch, who to recruit first, what to say), bullets of 3 backup games needing zero equipment, and a callout on when to just change the music and let it be.

disclaimer: Every game here works without alcohol; if drinks are involved, keep them optional and drink responsibly.
